name: ListenThis AI
author: ListenThis AI

sections.description:
This plugin allows the readers of your website to consume your content via audio.
The way it works is, integrate it with wordpress and in each post/page, add a
listenthis-ai block. Only the place where this block is added will a play button
show saying “Listen To This” along with a description that the content is narrated
by AI.

The way it works is that our servers will automatically detect which pages/posts
you have marked for “being narrated by AI”. We would then run a text-to-speech model
to generate the audio files which will be served to your readers.

Is this Software as a Service?

Yes.

Do I have to buy some kind of subscription?

Yes. You need to first buy a subscription and go through the onboarding process.
Without the subscription, the plugin won’t work.

Do I have to edit the template HTML?

No, we provide a “ListenThis AI” block which you can place at the top of your post.
This way you can change/update your template without worrying about what will happen
to the flow of the website.

What about all the historic posts?

You will have to go and edit them to add the “ListenThis AI” block. Without this,
those pages/posts won’t have the ability to listen to the content.

How does it look?

This plugin is deployed live here: https://wordpress-testing.listenthis.ai/audio-boosts-engagement/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zip file to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
